A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MMP-9 is a biomarker for acute atherothomobotic MI and that MMP-3 and 3 are biomarkers of acute MI.
MMPs are elevated in acute MI and specifically atherothrombiotic MI at time of acute event but not at the time of quiescent phase.
MMP-3 and MMP-9 are elevated at time of acute myocardial infarcation but not at the time of quiescent phase following acute infarction and that MMP-9 is also elevated at time of atherothrombosis.

MMP-3 and MMP-9 are significantly elevated at the time acute MI and that MMP-9 is specifically elevated in atherothrombosis.
